title: More Than 50 Vehicles Roll Through Nuevo Laredo in Hunting and Fishing Parade
excerpt: More than 50 vehicles took part in Nuevo Laredo's 2026 Hunting and Fishing Parade, a city-organized celebration of the region's hunting and fishing traditions that drew families along the route from the Explanada Independencia to the CIITEV palapas.
content:
More than 50 vehicles rolled through Nuevo Laredo in the city's 2026 Hunting and Fishing Parade, a celebration of the hunting and fishing traditions that run deep in the border region, according to REDTV Tamaulipas.

The Desfile Cinegético de Caza y Pesca 2026, organized by the Government of Nuevo Laredo, brought together hunting and fishing clubs and organizations along with families from across the city. The parade set out from the Explanada Independencia and traveled through city streets to the Palapas del CIITEV, where the gathering continued.

People of all ages lined up along the route to watch the parade, see the vehicles up close and take part in a shared space built around the customs and culture of the region, the report said.

Sources: REDTV Tamaulipas, Nov. 23, 2026; La Voz de Tamaulipas, Nov. 24, 2026.
